# Test fixtures

These files exercise parsers, gates and backend event handling. Names, application
namespaces and backend session/request/tool identities use generic or synthetic
values. Repeated IDs intentionally correlate events within a transcript; keep
those relationships when editing a fixture and update exact-value assertions.

Backend usage counts and event structures retain the parser cases they exercise.
Public API endpoints, SDK/model names and documentation links remain technical
references. Files that test malformed frontmatter or missing source references
remain intentionally incomplete; they are test input, not runnable project plans.

Do not add personal names, private tenant/account URLs, credentials or developer
checkout paths. Use generic roles, example domains and synthetic identities.
